data.one_liner: A simple static HTTP file server for local directory hosting
data.what_it_does: Provides a command-line static HTTP file server to easily serve any local directory, inspired by Python's SimpleHTTPServer. It supports custom ports, hosts, response headers, directory listing fallback, and HTTPS configuration.
use_when: You need to quickly serve a local web build during development
You want a simple CLI utility to share local static files over HTTP or HTTPS
avoid_when: You need a production-grade web server with complex routing and application logic
You are writing an embedded Dart app that needs programmatic HTTP serving rather than a CLI tool
strengths: Easy installation and global execution via dart pub global
Supports custom headers, file listing, and HTTPS configuration
weaknesses: Designed primarily as a CLI developer tool rather than a library for embedding in production apps
data.setup_notes: Install globally using `dart pub global activate dhttpd`
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate dhttpd
dhttpd --path build/web/
